name: IC Memory — Maxim
description: IC Memory cluster featuring surface-mount EEPROM devices in a Maxim TDFN-6-1EP footprint.
selection_hints: Requiring surface-mount Maxim memory IC components.
Using a Maxim TDFN-6-1EP 3x3mm footprint on the PCB layout.
Selecting between DS2431Q and DS28E07Q tier B parts.
avoid_when: Through-hole mounting or non-SMD assembly is required.
A package footprint other than Maxim TDFN-6-1EP 3x3mm is needed.
Components outside the IC Memory class or Maxim family are required.
